68: /**

70:  * adapters provide the ports; this function only wires them together and
71:  * resolves the runtime profile through a registry-like selection.
72:  */
73: export function createOperationalHarness(
74:   options: OperationalHarnessOptions
75: ): OperationalHarness {
76:   const capabilityFingerprint = options.capabilities?.compositionFingerprint()
77:   if (options.capabilities && !options.effectJournal) {
78:     throw new Error(
79:       'Capability composition requires an explicit effect journal'
80:     )
81:   }
82:   const tools = resolveTools(options, capabilityFingerprint)
83:   const singlePass = new SinglePassGovernedRuntime({
84:     orchestrator: options.orchestrator ?? new SinglePassOrchestrator(),
85:     modelGateway: options.modelGateway,
86:     policy: options.policy,
87:     approvals: options.approvals,
88:     tools,
89:     ...(capabilityFingerprint ? { capabilityFingerprint } : {}),
90:     audit: options.audit,
91:     telemetry: options.telemetry,
92:     ...(options.pause ? { pause: options.pause } : {}),
93:     ...(options.effects ? { effects: options.effects } : {}),
94:     ...(options.log ? { log: options.log } : {}),
95:     ...(options.sandbox ? { sandbox: options.sandbox } : {})
96:   })
97: 
98:   const iterative =
99:     options.iterativeOrchestrator && options.stepStore
100:       ? new IterativeGovernedRuntime({
130: 
131:   const resolveProfile = (input: RuntimeInput): RuntimeProfile =>
132:     input.runtimeProfile ?? options.defaultRuntimeProfile ?? 'single_pass'
133: 
134:   const execute = async (input: RuntimeInput): Promise<RuntimeResult> => {
135:     const governedInput = capabilityFingerprint
136:       ? { ...input, capabilityFingerprint }
137:       : input
138:     if (
139:       capabilityFingerprint &&
140:       input.executionId &&
141:       input.capabilityFingerprint === undefined
142:     ) {
143:       await safeAudit(options, input, 'runtime.stopped', 'STATE_CONFLICT')

146:           'Capability composition fingerprint is required for durable execution.',
147:         stopReason: 'STATE_CONFLICT',
148:         steps: 0,
149:         modelCalls: 0,
150:         toolCalls: 0,

152:       }
153:     }
154:     if (
155:       capabilityFingerprint &&
156:       input.capabilityFingerprint !== undefined &&
157:       input.capabilityFingerprint !== capabilityFingerprint
158:     ) {
159:       await safeAudit(options, input, 'runtime.stopped', 'STATE_CONFLICT')
160:       return {
161:         response:
162:           'Capability composition fingerprint does not match the runtime.',
163:         stopReason: 'STATE_CONFLICT',
164:         steps: 0,
165:         modelCalls: 0,
166:         toolCalls: 0,
167:         usage: { inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, costUsd: 0 }
168:       }
169:     }
170:     const profile = resolveProfile(governedInput)
171:     if (profile === 'iterative') {
172:       if (!iterative) {
173:         await safeAudit(
174:           options,
175:           governedInput,
176:           'runtime.stopped',
177:           'STATE_CONFLICT'
178:         )
179:         return {
180:           response:
181:             'The iterative runtime profile is not configured in this composition.',
182:           stopReason: 'STATE_CONFLICT',
183:           steps: 0,
184:           modelCalls: 0,
185:           toolCalls: 0,
186:           usage: { inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, costUsd: 0 }
187:         }
188:       }

190:     }
191:     return singlePass.execute(governedInput)
192:   }

194:   return {

35:   observations: readonly Observation[]
36: ): Observation | undefined {

40: function toolObservationIsEffect(observation: Observation): boolean {
41:   const payload = observation.payload as {
42:     status?: unknown
43:     sideEffect?: unknown
44:   } | null
45:   if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false
46:   if (payload.status !== 'SUCCEEDED') return false
47:   return payload.sideEffect === 'WRITE' || payload.sideEffect === 'EXTERNAL'
48: }
49: 
50: /**
51:  * A confirmed action must be grounded in the claimed effect: either the exact
52:  * tool named by the decision succeeded with a side effect, or (when no tool is
53:  * named) at least one side-effecting tool succeeded. A previous successful
54:  * read never satisfies an action-confirmation claim.
55:  */
56: function hasConfirmedEffect(
57:   decision: { readonly toolId?: string },
58:   observations: readonly Observation[]
59: ): boolean {
60:   const effects = observations.filter(
61:     (observation) =>
62:       observation.type === 'TOOL_RESULT' && toolObservationIsEffect(observation)
63:   )
64:   if (decision.toolId) {
65:     return effects.some(
66:       (observation) => observation.provenance.sourceId === decision.toolId
67:     )
68:   }
69:   return effects.length > 0
70: }

72: function toolObservationFailed(observation: Observation): boolean {
73:   const payload = observation.payload as { status?: unknown } | null
74:   if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false
75:   return payload.status === 'FAILED' || payload.status === 'REJECTED'
76: }

94: /**

100: export class DeterministicCompletionEvaluator implements CompletionEvaluator {
101:   private readonly strategy: CompletionStrategy
102:   private readonly semanticJudge: SemanticCompletionJudge | undefined
103: 
104:   public constructor(options: CompletionEvaluatorOptions = {}) {
105:     this.strategy = options.strategy ?? 'DETERMINISTIC'
106:     this.semanticJudge = options.semanticJudge
107:   }
108: 
109:   public async evaluate(
110:     input: CompletionEvaluationInput
111:   ): Promise<CompletionEvaluation> {
112:     const deterministic = this.evaluateDeterministic(input)
113:     if (deterministic.outcome !== 'COMPLETE') {
114:       return deterministic
115:     }
116:     if (this.strategy !== 'HYBRID' || !this.semanticJudge) {
117:       return deterministic
118:     }
119:     try {
120:       const judged = await this.semanticJudge.judge(input)
121:       return judged
122:     } catch {
123:       return {
124:         ...deterministic,
125:         // Unreachable: every deterministic COMPLETE carries a detail.
126:         /* v8 ignore next 2 */
127:         detail:
128:           `${deterministic.detail ?? ''} semantic_judge_unavailable`.trim(),
129:         reasonCode: 'EVALUATOR_UNAVAILABLE'
130:       }
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   private evaluateDeterministic(
135:     input: CompletionEvaluationInput
136:   ): CompletionEvaluation {
137:     const lastTool = lastToolObservation(input.observations)
138:     const lastSufficiency = sufficiencyFromObservation(
139:       lastOfType(input.observations, 'SUFFICIENCY')
140:     )
141: 
142:     if (input.state.pendingQuestion) {
143:       return {
144:         outcome: 'NEEDS_USER',
145:         reasonCode: 'MISSING_INFORMATION',
146:         deterministic: true,
147:         detail: 'A clarification question is still pending.'
148:       }
149:     }
150:     if (input.state.pendingApprovalId) {
